dialog.fatal.title: wchron can't start
error.storage.unavailable: The data folder {path} can't be created or written, so wchron can't start. Check the folder permissions and the free disk space.
error.storage.backup_failed: Backing up the data to {path} failed, so wchron doesn't start, to protect your data. Free some disk space or check the folder permissions.
error.config.read_failed: The configuration file {path} can't be read. wchron doesn't start and leaves the file as it is: restore it from the backups folder.
error.config.write_failed: Couldn't save the configuration to {path}: the change was not applied.
error.config.newer_version: Your data was saved by a newer version of wchron (format {found}; this version supports up to {supported}). wchron doesn't start and doesn't touch it: install the newer version.
error.config.migration_failed: Updating the data format from version {from} to {to} failed. The original files are untouched and backed up.
error.config.invalid: The configuration file {path} has an invalid value in {field}. wchron doesn't start and leaves the file as it is: fix it or restore it from the backups folder.
error.state.read_failed: The last-run information in {path} couldn't be read and was reset (the old file is kept next to it). Schedules keep working.
error.state.write_failed: The last-run information couldn't be saved to {path}.
error.devenv.invalid: Invalid development setting {name}={value}: fix it in .env or in the environment.
error.logs.read_failed: The log files can't be read.
error.token.unclosed: The { at character {pos} is never closed: add the matching }, or write {{ for a literal brace.
error.token.unexpected_close: The } at character {pos} has no matching {: write }} for a literal brace.
error.token.unknown: Unknown token "{name}" at character {pos}: the only token is date, as in {date:DD-MM-YYYY}.
error.token.format_invalid: Invalid date format "{format}" at character {pos}: use the letters YYYY, YY, MMMM, MMM, MM, M, DD, D, dddd, ddd, HH, H, mm, ss.
error.token.offset_invalid: "{offset}" at character {pos} is not a valid date change: use offsets like -1d, +2w, -1m, +1y or anchors like @month-start, @week-end.
error.token.empty: Empty token at character {pos}: write one like {date:DD-MM-YYYY}, or {{}} for literal braces.
error.autostart.failed: Couldn't change the start with Windows setting: Windows refused to write it.
error.keepawake.failed: Windows refused to keep the PC awake.
error.cadence.interval_invalid: The interval must be between 1 minute and 24 hours.
error.cadence.anchor_invalid: "{value}" is not a valid start time: use HH:MM, e.g. 08:30.
error.cadence.window_invalid: The time window must start and end at different times.
error.cadence.window_empty: No send of this interval falls inside the time window: widen the window or change the interval or the start time.
error.cadence.time_invalid: "{value}" is not a valid time: use HH:MM, e.g. 14:00.
error.cadence.time_duplicate: {value} is in the list more than once.
error.slot.missed: {schedule}: skipped sends: {count} (from {from} to {to}), because the PC was asleep or off or the clock changed. They are not recovered.
error.slot.late: {schedule}: the send of {slot} was skipped because it would have started more than 5 minutes late.
error.slot.dst_gap: {schedule}: the send of {slot} was skipped: that time doesn't exist on the day the clocks go forward.
error.slot.dst_repeat: {schedule}: {slot} came round a second time when the clocks went back; it is sent only once.
error.slot.paused: {schedule}: skipped sends: {count} (from {from} to {to}), because the routine was paused.
error.slot.overlap: {schedule}: the send of {slot} was skipped because the previous one was still in progress.
error.internal: Unexpected error. The details are in the log.
